title: Acids and bases - 123 school
heading: Acids and bases
intro: You learn these terms and calculations by practising. Only use BINAS when the question names a BINAS table.

questions.question: What is an acid?

answers.a: A particle that can take up an electron
answers.b: A particle that can give up an OH<sup>-</sup>
answers.c: A particle that can donate an H<sup>+</sup>
answers.d: A particle that can accept an H<sup>+</sup>

questions.question: What is a base?

answers.a: A particle that can accept an H<sup>+</sup>
answers.b: A particle that can take up an OH<sup>-</sup>
answers.c: A particle that can donate an H<sup>+</sup>
answers.d: A particle that can give up an electron

What does it mean that HCl is a strong acid?

answers.a: HCl gives up only part of its H<sup>+</sup>

answers.c: HCl does not dissolve in water
answers.d: A lot of HCl is dissolved

questions.question: What does it mean that acetic acid is a weak acid?

answers.b: All molecules give up an H<sup>+</sup>
answers.d: Only a small fraction of the molecules donates an H<sup>+</sup> (equilibrium)
